item.title: Welcome
item.dc:creator: Ze Wang
item.description:
This is the new home for my writing and projects. The old site (a Hugo + blogdown academic page from my University of Missouri years) is preserved separately; this site is built on Quarto and reflects where I work now — as a Research Scientist at AWS.

Expect posts on causal inference, psychometrics in industry, machine learning at AWS scale, and the occasional GenAI experiment.
